purpose: Implement the public general-equipment List UI on top of the frozen Stage 4-0 consumer contract and Stage 4-1 route/loader scaffold without re-deriving Equipment semantics.

display.name: nameKr ?? nameCn
display.iconPolicy: The frozen icon source field remains in the consumer payload, but no web-served Equipment icon asset set exists in the repository at Stage 4-2. Do not emit broken image URLs or fabricate mappings; visual icon binding is deferred until extracted assets are published.
display.ordering: Filter the Stage 3 generated record sequence in place. Frontend must not re-sort by equipmentId or claim exact release chronology.

requirements: The /equipment route renders all 206 general records through the frozen loader.
Tab counts remain 94/80/32 and exactly one tab is active.
Group/subtype filters follow the generated taxonomy and preserve source order.
Tab/group/subtype UI state persists across reload/revisit and invalid saved state is sanitized.
Every rendered card links by exact equipmentId to /equipment/$equipmentId.
No hidden/special/HOLD record is introduced and no release chronology is invented.
